summary: Hesai Group filed a Form 6-K reporting its annual general meeting scheduled for June 26, 2026. The filing includes the AGM notice, circular, and proxy form, with resolutions related to a proposed share subdivision and change in board lot size, as part of a routine corporate governance event. The board recommends that shareholders and ADS holders vote in favor of the proposed resolutions. This is a standard AGM notice with no special situation trigger such as a merger, tender offer, or activist campaign. No deal terms or price-related information are provided. As a foreign private issuer, this 6-K serves as the equivalent of a U.S. proxy statement filing.
